description: Use when the user wants the same feed as `list_news_movers` pre-grouped into the 14 canonical categories, as in 'what is moving in politics?'; for one ranked feed use `list_news_movers`, and for a plain 24h ranking by size of move `top_movers`. Returns the same data shape as `list_news_movers`, with cluster grouping inside each bucket.

include_entertainment.description: Include entertainment markets (default: excluded for signal-to-noise).
include_entertainment.title: Include Entertainment

include_resolved.description: Include resolved (closed) markets (default: excluded — news movers focus on live markets).
include_resolved.title: Include Resolved

min_score.description: Minimum spike score. Higher = more notable spikes only.
min_score.title: Min Score

per_category.description: Max items per category bucket (1-50; default 11).
per_category.title: Per Category

q.description: Full-text search across market title and event title. Case-insensitive substring match.
q.title: Q

source.description: Platform ID(s); single value or comma-separated list. Allowed: polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion, gemini.
source.title: Source

name: news_movers_by_category
title: News movers by category
